post.description: Completes a proof-based account link: the caller presents the link challenge issued when a provider sign-in matched an existing account, plus that account's password and, when TOTP is configured, an authenticator code. Binds the identity, opens a session and is rate limited per address.
Emails the account holder a confirmation link for a pending identity-link challenge, for accounts that prefer email proof over a password prompt. Rate limited per address.

get.description: Confirmation target of the link email: verifies the challenge token, binds the identity and opens a session in the browser. Rate limited per address.

200.description: HTML confirmation page or redirect into the console

get.description: Lists the social and workspace SSO identities linked to the caller's account, with provider, subject and link time. Subjects are provider identifiers, not credentials.

post.description: Removes one linked identity from the caller's account by issuer or provider plus subject, and drops its identity binding. Audited as auth.identity_unlinked.

404.description: Identity not linked to this account
